entries.title: Isaiah 25:1
segments: O LORD, You [are] my God; I will exalt You, I will praise Your name; for You have done a wonder; Counsels from afar; faithful faithfulness.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:2
segments: For You have made a heap from a city; a fortified city into a ruin; a citadel of foreigners to be no city; it shall never be built.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:3
segments: Therefore the strong people glorify You, the city of the fearful nations shall fear You.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:4
segments: For You are a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the fearful ones [is] like a storm [against] the wall.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:5
segments: You shalt bring down the noise of foreigners, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of cloud. The shouting of the terrifying ones shall be brought low.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:6
segments: And in this mountain the LORD of hosts shall make a feast of fat things for all the people, a feast of wine on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of refined wine on the lees.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:7
segments: And He will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering which covers all people, and the veil that is woven over all nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:8
segments: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord Jehovah will wipe away tears from all faces. And He shall take away from all the earth the rebuke of His people. For the LORD has spoken.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:9
segments: And one shall say in that day, Lo, this [is] our God. We have waited for Him, and He will save us. This [is] the LORD; we have waited for Him, we will be glad and rejoice in His salvation.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:10
segments: For the hand of the LORD shall rest in this mountain, and Moab shall be trampled under Him, even as straw [is] trampled in the water of a dung pit.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:11
segments: And He shall spread out His hands in their midst, as he who swims strokes to swim. And He shall bring down their pride with the skill of His hands.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:12
segments: And the fortress of the high fort of your walls [He will] lay low, bring to the ground, to the dust.
